close_reason: Decision: SEED CONTRACT comment correctly specifies Trash mailbox ID assertion. No code change needed.
description: The old SEED CONTRACT comment described the wrong future assertion — 'does not contain the inbox ID' would pass even if role filtering were completely broken (returning all mailboxes). The new comment specifies 'assert ids contains exactly the Trash mailbox ID', which is a positive oracle that will fail if filtering regresses. This is the correct way to document a test-data dependency. A future contributor might be tempted to revert to the weaker negative assertion for simplicity; this comment is the right place to block that.
title: SEED CONTRACT comment now correctly specifies the positive assertion needed
